title: Bird transect survey map with linked table

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: The 296 observations are generated from a fixed seed: six transects walked twice in each of three seasons, with species picked by habitat and season. The reserve outline, transect lines and habitat zones are invented and hard-coded; loading a CSV replaces the observations but keeps that outline. Observers are initials only.
